Joins Montgomery tracts with 2025 code violation counts and CDC adult high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, and returns the cross-tract correlation and paired tract count with nulls last and geoid retained for mapping.
sql:
WITH cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_11b2fe_m2_cdc
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_11b2fe'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    t.name,
    t.geoid,
    cd.totalpopulation,
    cd.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
    (COALESCE(c.violation_count, 0) / NULLIF(cd.totalpopulation, 0)) * 1000.0 AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  LEFT JOIN cdc cd ON t.geoid = cd.geoid
)
SELECT
  name,
  code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
  adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  totalpopulation,
  CORR(code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS correlation,
  SUM(CASE WHEN code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL AND adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM joined
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name
LIMIT 200
